msg.sender is compared with minter in the onlyMinter modifier.
onlyHolder verifies msg.sender owns the NFT being auctioned.

block.timestamp plus prolongation determines the adjusted auction end time.
block.timestamp decides whether an auction is currently active.

Bid amount is passed into stablecoin.transferFrom.

bid invokes the external stablecoin.transferFrom call.
bid calls _refundBid to return funds to the previous highest bidder.
_refundBid performs an external stablecoin transfer, enabling reentrancy before bid state updates.
bid indirectly triggers an external token transfer during refund before finalizing highest bid state.
artId indexes the auctions mapping in completeAuction.
highestBidder is read from auctions[artId] storage.
highestBid is read from auctions[artId] storage.

stablecoin state variable is the target of the external transfers in processPayment.
nft state variable is the target of the external transferFrom in completeAuction.
